summary: Harden skills regular-file inode checks, reference delimiters, and regex anchors

delivery.outcome: Enforce lstat+fstat (st_dev, st_ino) regular-file identity, relative ancestor symlink rejection, and max_bytes integer bounds in read_regular_utf8; harden validate_safe_reference against backslash/query/fragment and colon-delimited dot-dot segments; centralize and anchor all regexes with \A...\Z across skill_primitives.py, conformance.py, execution_errors.py, execution_conformance.py, and operation_profile_conformance.py; expand test_skills_hardening.py; and close merged ticket-012.
nonGoals: No breaking changes to skill.schema.json, skill-execution.schema.json, or skill-operation-profile.schema.json

architecture.decision: Centralize \A...\Z-anchored regex patterns and compile_anchored_pattern in standard/skill_primitives.py, enforce pre-open lstat and post-open fstat inode identity plus relative ancestor symlink guards in read_regular_utf8, tighten colon/query/fragment/backslash checks in validate_safe_reference, and deduplicate regex constants across conformance modules.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch commit or close the pull request before merge.
